comparison: Both evaluate the primary conclusions (C20-C22). OpenEval finds them SUPPORTED by experimental data and model fitting. Peer reviewers rate them UNCERTAIN, acknowledging importance but raising substantive concerns about data analysis, model fitting quality, and contradictions with previous studies. Major disagreement on confidence level.

Both evaluate claims about gating current measurements reflecting closed-state voltage sensor movements (C23, C24, C26). OpenEval finds them SUPPORTED by Figure 1A-B data. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting additional ionic current comparisons at same voltages and expressing concern about potential contamination from later voltage sensor movements. Disagreement on sufficiency of evidence.

Both evaluate OFF-gating current kinetics claims (C34-C39). OpenEval finds them SUPPORTED by Figure 2 data and kinetic analysis. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting apparent discrepancies between small 2.5-fold Ca-dependent change in OFF kinetics versus large Q-V shift, questioning how effects reconcile with proposed 26-fold equilibrium constant change. Significant disagreement on internal consistency.

Both evaluate model fitting and concerted interaction mechanism (C78). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by AIC analysis strongly favoring Model II. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, challenging adequacy of model testing since both models use single Ca site per subunit inconsistent with two-site conclusion, and noting neither model fits data well. Major disagreement on model validation.

Both address assumption that Ca2+ re-equilibration is fast relative to voltage sensor movement (C49). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by kinetic simulations in Figure 3—figure supplement 2. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, expressing substantial concern that Ca-equilibration may only be 4-5x slower than voltage sensor movement and requesting additional simulation analysis. Disagreement on validity of critical assumption.

Both evaluate theoretical framework and model assumptions (C41, C44, C46). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as accurate description of HA model and logical inferences. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, accepting mathematical framework while requesting clarification of assumptions. Agreement that framework is appropriately described.

Both evaluate mutant analysis showing equal contributions from RCK1 and RCK2 sites (C88, C89, C91). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by Figure 5 data showing nearly identical energetic contributions. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, with Reviewer #3 calling evidence 'compelling' for independent and additive influence. Strong agreement on this key experimental finding.

Both evaluate independent contributions and additive effects of Ca2+ binding sites (C58, C64, C92). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by mutant analysis showing similar energetic contributions. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, explicitly noting sites act 'independently, and largely additively.' Strong agreement on independent pathways.

Partial overlap on mutant findings. OpenEval R8 evaluates C56, C58, C61, C64 as SUPPORTED. Peer R5 evaluates overlapping claims C61, C88, C89, C91 as SUPPORTED. Both agree on equal contribution of both Ca2+ binding sites based on mutant data, though they group slightly different claim sets.

Both evaluate speculative claims about gradual expansion mechanism (C79-C81). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting claims are explicitly speculative and lack direct experimental validation. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, accepting speculation as reasonable discussion based on structural analogies. Minor disagreement, though both acknowledge speculative nature.

Both evaluate cooperativity and model limitations (C92-C100). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting cooperativity question remains unresolved with model fitting yielding unrealistic KD values. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, accepting authors' balanced discussion and acknowledgment of limitations. Agreement that cooperativity is unresolved, but differ on whether discussion adequately addresses this.

Both evaluate claims citing prior fluorescence and structural studies (C72, C73, C75, C82, C84, C85, C86). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as accurate representation of cited literature. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, accepting interpretation of published structural data as reasonable. Agreement on literature-based claims.

Partial overlap on structural literature claims. OpenEval R12 evaluates C82, C84, C85, C86 as SUPPORTED while noting current findings challenge prior RCK1-dominant view. Peer R9 evaluates overlapping claims as SUPPORTED, accepting interpretation of structural studies. Agreement on literature interpretation.

Both evaluate background claims about BK channel structure and function (C1-C10). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as well-established background knowledge with extensive citations. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, accepting background as accurate representation of the field. Strong agreement on foundational context.

Both evaluate background claims about prior knowledge and open questions (C11-C19). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as accurate summary with appropriate citations. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED (R12 covers C1-C19), accepting established facts about BK channels. Strong agreement on background literature.

Both evaluate methodological details (C101-C105). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as standard and appropriate methods. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, accepting methodological approach while requesting some clarifications. Agreement that basic methods are appropriate.

Both address acknowledgment of study limitations (C100). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED as reasonable concluding statement. Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED (within R11 covering C93-C100), accepting balanced discussion of limitations. Agreement on appropriate acknowledgment of model limitations.

Minimal overlap. OpenEval R8 evaluates C56 among other mutant claims as SUPPORTED. Peer R13 evaluates C56, C87, C90 as SUPPORTED, accepting established mutant properties from literature. Agreement on mutant characterization where claims overlap.

Minimal overlap. OpenEval R9 evaluates C87 among other claims as SUPPORTED by Figure 5 data. Peer R13 evaluates C87 as SUPPORTED based on established mutant properties. Agreement on mutant data where claims overlap.
